image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) standing in a grassy field. The bird displays glossy black plumage with iridescent blue-green sheen on the neck and breast, prominent red eyebrow combs (caruncles), and a short curved beak. White undertail coverts are visible at the rear, and the tail feathers show the characteristic lyre shape curving outward. Legs appear feathered.
